name: neobrutalism-textareas
title: Textareas
description: Neobrutalism-style textarea components built with Tailwind CSS. Featuring thick borders, hard shadows, and resizable layouts. Perfect for comments, messages, and long-form input with a retro, neobrutalist aesthetic.
useWhen: Collecting a comment, message, description, or other multi-line text with a bold visual treatment.
Pairing long-form input with supporting actions such as attachment or submit controls.
avoidWhen: Collecting a single-line value — use an input.
Building rich-text editing with formatting controls.
responsiveBehavior: Textareas fill their container and remain resizable without causing page overflow. Embedded actions stack or move below the field on narrow screens.
accessibility: Use a visible label, and connect character limits or help text through aria-describedby.
Do not convey validation state using color alone.
